summary:
Second scenario check (action=check) for the already-accepted requirement unit-claim-heartbeat-header-gate, measuring the downstream consequence of the skipped RPC-header gate; preflight-validated with valid=True and no diagnostics.

Design: plan_c6.json plus harness_hbv_test.go build voter nodes with background goroutines disabled and a bootstrapped three-voter configuration. On the tested node a pure heartbeat with an out-of-window protocol version is delivered through processHeartbeat (the body of the handler installed by SetHeartbeatHandler), then a RequestVote from a configured candidate is driven through the production dispatch processRPC. Declarative prerequisite: ghost_heartbeat_out_of_window and candidate_is_configured_voter. Property: an implication on the result event — if the receiver adopted the ghost as its known leader, then the legitimate vote is rejected — with the premise carried by the antecedent rather than duplicated as an applicability filter (the first preflight rejected the overlap and it was corrected), identity op_id, and the oracle reading emitted fields rather than tests_passed.

Construction evidence (not the formal observation): a local run in a copy of the captured module produced the chain the scenario is about — ghost_leader_adopted true with legitimate_vote_granted false on the tested node, versus no leader and granted true on the control that never saw the heartbeat — so the bypass has a direct availability consequence on the formation path: a legitimate election is suppressed because the receiver believes a foreign, out-of-window peer is the leader.

Declared limits: reachability of an out-of-window peer in a legal deployment remains the requirement's open premise and the scenario assumes it; no timing is exercised, so the duration of the suppression is not measured; and no live cluster, term interaction or election is exercised. No target code was modified.

Run state: four confirmed in-scope violations with no pending review work; this product adds measured consequence for the heartbeat finding rather than a new question.
